claves: El tubo germinal es una prolongación corta y sin septos, de la mitad del ancho y 3 a 4 veces el largo de la célula de donde sale. Se ve al incubar Candida en suero a 37 °C por 2 a 4 horas.

imagen.descripcionOriginal: Germ tube is a short outgrowth, non-septate germinating hypha. It is ½ the width and 3 – 4 times the length of the cell from which it arises. When Candida species are incubated in serum at 37°C for 2-4 hours and produce short, slender, tube-like structures called germ tubes. The formation of this germ tube is associated with increased synthesis of protein and ribonucleic acid and is observed in Candida albicans.
